questions.text: What is the primary distinction between Data Analysis and Data Science regarding their core objectives?

options.text: Data Analysis focuses on creating complex machine learning algorithms, while Data Science focuses on data entry.
Data Analysis focuses on answering questions about what happened in the past, while Data Science focuses on predicting what will happen in the future.
Data Analysis requires unstructured data, while Data Science only uses structured data.
Data Analysis involves building data pipelines, while Data Science involves visualizing dashboards.

questions.text: Which of the following datasets is an example of unstructured data?

options.text: An Excel spreadsheet containing sales transaction records.
A SQL database table listing customer names and addresses.
A folder containing audio recordings of customer service calls.
A CSV file with inventory counts organized by product ID.

questions.text: In the 'Process' phase of the 6 Steps of Analysis (Ask, Prepare, Process, Analyze, Share, Act), what is the primary task performed by an analyst?

options.text: Creating visualizations to share with stakeholders.
Cleaning the data to fix errors, remove duplicates, and handle missing values.
Collecting the data from various sources.
Defining the business problem and objectives.
